title: Quantum Electrodynamics: a visual laboratory
summary: QED as 76 interactive views in three synchronized, related but distinct lenses, never identified with one another: perturbative QFT (fields, propagators, diagrams, amplitudes), Connes–Kreimer renormalization with noncommutative spectral geometry, and local operator algebras. Flagships carry the one-loop vacuum polarization from its momentum integral through the Laurent series in ε, MS and MS-bar subtraction and the running coupling to the Birkhoff factorization of a Hopf-algebra character; a finite spectral triple fluctuated into a U(1) gauge field with link phases, fluxes and the spectral action; and a spacetime region carried to its Tomita–Takesaki modular flow, KMS condition and wedge boost. With a Feynman-graph analyser (loops, 1PI, degree of divergence, divergent subgraphs, coproduct and forests), independent Python reference values, the concept graph as the menu, a command palette, a presentation mode, Markdown export, a narrated beamdswitch deck and a self-test badge. Every number is computed by the engine or quoted with its source, and toy and finite models are labelled as such. Runs offline.
